title: Diagnostic.X at Karolinska Solna
summary: A walkable medical campus on Karolinska University Hospital's Solna grounds between Brunnsviken lake and pine forest. Four zones anchor the visitor journey: a public diagnostic kiosk, a 4D imaging consultation room, a molecular VR lab, and a metaverse medical office staffed by AI avatars (projects in progress per source).

quests.title: First Check at the Kiosk
steps: Register at the Medical Kiosk touchscreen
Complete the guided screen diagnostic with the Medical AI Avatar
Follow the pine path to the Imaging Consultation Suite
Hand results to the Imaging AI for 4D rendering

quests.title: Walk Around the Injury
steps: Step onto the walk-around floor dial in the 4D Volumetric Theater
Resize the 4D injury hologram with the gesture ring
Compare against the 2D X-ray wall
Take the summary to the Office AI Avatar at the Metaverse Medical Office

quests.title: Inside the Molecule
steps: Meet the Scientist Assistant Avatar at Biomedicum VR Lab
Ride the molecule-scale transport platform into a protein structure
Edit a residue with the haptic manipulators
Return and project the edited structure in the 4D Theater

quests.title: Open the Office
steps: Customize a practitioner office with the Office AI Avatar
Set the virtual certificate wall and records terminal
Book a follow-up kiosk screening
Return to the kiosk forecourt at sunset to close the tour

quests.title: Lakeside Rounds
steps: Start at the kiosk forecourt greeting hut
Walk the Brunnsviken shore path past pine and moss ground
Collect a diagnostic token from each zone's avatar agent
Deliver all four tokens to the Scientist Assistant Avatar
